2. Heard Sri Mohammad Mujtaba Zuber for Sri Abdul Muqhtadir, learned counsel for the petitioner,

sentences.text:
In view of the rival contentions urged by the learned counsels for both the parties, the point that would arise for my consideration is:
"Whether the criminal proceedings initiated against the petitioners is liable to be quashed invoking inherent power under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023?"
NC: 2025:KHC-K:5110 HC-KAR

My answer to the above point is in 'Affirmative' for the following:
REASONS 4.

Respondent No.2 filed the first information with the Women Police Station, Kalaburagi City,
against accused Nos.1 to 3 alleging commission of the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 323,
504 and 506 read with 34 of IPC.
After investigation, charge-sheet came to be filed for the said offences.
Accused No.1 is the husband of respondent No.2, accused No.2 is the brother of accused No.1 and accused No.3 is wife of accused No.2.
It is noticed that accused No.2 is aged 78 years and accused No.3 is 75 years.
It is stated that they are residing separately at Sindhanoor, while accused No.1 is residing in Kalaburagi and respondent No.2 is residing separately.
The allegations made by the informant are mainly against accused No.1.
The only allegation against NC: 2025:KHC-K:5110 HC-KAR the petitioners is that they treated the informant with cruelty by abusing her.
5. The incident alleged to have occurred on 23.08.2023.
The first information was filed on 02.09.2023 against accused Nos.1 to 3 making bald and general allegations against accused Nos.2 and 3.

I find considerable force in the contention taken by the learned counsel for the petitioners that deliberately these petitioners were roped in even though they are aged and they are residing separately.
Under such circumstances, I am of the opinion that continuation of the criminal proceedings against the petitioners is in abuse of process of law.

6. Accordingly, I answer the above point in the 'Affirmative' and proceed to pass the following:
ORDER (i) The petition is allowed.

NC: 2025:KHC-K:5110 HC-KAR (ii) Pending criminal proceedings initiated against the petitioners/accused Nos.2 and 3 in Crime No.116/2023 of Women Police Station, Kalaburagi City, pending in C.C.No.9714/2024, on the file of learned I Additional Civil Judge (Jr.Dn.) and J.M.F.C. Court, Kalaburagi,
for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 read with 34 of IPC, is quashed.

Sd/-
